column1: # Template for published 2050 airfare cost data (cost_source: published).
# Save filled-in copy as raw-data/airfare_costs_published.csv. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# One row per country x fuel pathway. fare_change_* = % airfare increase in 2050 vs a kerosene counterfactual.
# fuel_family: eSAF | GBF | mixed. gbf_share (0-1): GBF share of fuel
# fare_change_low/high: range across the study's scenarios (any order is fine; it is sorted on read).
# reference: short citation for the source of each row.
